resources.string: Shows pinyin above Chinese text when you tap the accessibility button.

When you tap the accessibility button, Rubify takes a screenshot, recognizes the Chinese characters in it and shows their pinyin above them. Rubify acts only when you tap. It does not read screen content at any other time, and screenshots are processed on this device and never uploaded.
Rubify shows pinyin above Chinese characters on your screen. Enable the Rubify accessibility service, then tap the accessibility button whenever you want pinyin for what is on screen.
